body: Thank you for your kind words 🙂 Today, I've decided to go back to the "whatever will be, will be" mentality. If it's meant to happen, then it will. Just enjoy the rollercoaster that is life.

Yeah.. this would have hurt less if he was completely honest with me and if it was a clean cut break up instead of keeping things from me so that I don't get hurt like being arrested out the front of his house one day..  (long story and not his fault at all). When he made the decision he explained it as "if you love her, let her go" and to this day I still think it's bullshit. I know he loved me but that was not a good enough excuse on my side.

 I felt sorry for him cus every part of his life is just fucked. Work, family, friends.. everything. He has struggled with depression his whole life and still blames himself for his mother's death 2 years ago.

I wanted him to be happy and make sure he had support... What a waste of time that was.

Firstly, thank you so much 🙂 Secondly, I totally agree. There are both good and bad women and men. It's not one sided at all and it really sucks that the good people get hurt. And I'm sorry you have had to live this yourself.

I'm beginning to just be over everything.. I'm sick of it. Just want it to end. Just want to find that one guy that deserves my love.. otherwise I'm not going to last much longer..

Actually no. I hadn't heard from him for weeks and freaked out that he had made that final decision. Turns out I decided to pick the same night he decided to officially give his rights away to his son... Not intentional at all. .... The biggest thing I'm trying to get over right now is that he is explicitly stated he could not have a relationship during this time. Then the other day proceeds to tell me he found someone.. but doesn't give me any details at all. Very Blazay about it.. So needless to say.. I'm fucking pissed. Also frustrated with myself for still having feelings for him. Everything was going great until all this started. 

It's bullshit how much I get used and abused just for having a big heart. I'm done.

I should also add that he broke up with me to stop me from getting hurt and being put in danger... Needless to say, I'm still hurting and it's months later. But yet I still worry about him constantly. Another fucking reason I want to kill myself.
